item.title: Huntsville Utilities concludes 'grace period'; Late-fee assessments and service disconnections back in effect
item.description: Huntsville Utilities is once again issuing late-fee assessments and conducting service disconnections following a six-month "grace period." The utility service had previously suspended the fees and disconnections on August 11 as part of a software system upgrade. item.description: A Birmingham woman is facing multiple charges after a robbery, police chase and crash.Kaudija Shondrelle Haynes, 32, was arrested Friday in connection to a robbery reported at the Leeds Chick-fil-A.Leeds Police responded to the robbery at 1808 Ashville Road. item.title: Ivey to deliver final state of the state address on Tuesday
item.description: Governor Kay Ivey will deliver her ninth state of the state address at 6 p.m. on Tuesday. item.title: 4 takeaways from No. 13 Alabama's 96-90 loss to No. 11 Vanderbilt
item.description: No. 13 Alabama dropped its first SEC game of the season against Vanderbilt 96-90 as the Commodores remain undefeated on the year.
